svg.text: Coolify Infra — Full Architecture & Deployment Flow
CI / CD PIPELINE (runs on every push, outside the VPC)
AWS ACCOUNT — us-east-1 (region is a variable)
t3.medium · own SSH key · + Elastic IP

PRIVATE SUBNETS (10.60.10.0/24, 10.60.11.0/24) — no public IP, no NAT (no outbound internet needed)
7-day automated backups + final snapshot on destroy

so failover to Multi-AZ later needs no subnet changes.
